fig1_kg_dispersion.svg: Klein-Gordon dispersion $\omega_p=\sqrt{p^2+m^2}$ from kg_dispersion for $m=0,1,2$ (natural units $\hbar=c=1$). The massless field is the light cone $\omega_p=|p|$ (orange); a mass opens a gap, so each massive branch starts at the rest energy $\omega(0)=m$ and bends up to meet the light cone at large $|p|$.
fig2_vacuum_energy_uv.svg: Regularized vacuum energy $E_0=\frac{1}{2}\sum_p\omega_p$ from vacuum_energy, summing the half-quantum of every box mode $|p|\le\Lambda$ for a massless field (dots; $n_{modes}$ grows from 33 to 17077). It is finite for any finite cutoff but follows the power law $E_0\propto\Lambda^4$ (dashed): doubling $\Lambda$ multiplies $E_0$ by $\approx2^4=16$ — the UV divergence tamed by normal-ordering / renormalization.
